title: Wet ink
description: A booking form's signature field on real paper — the pen signs itself, rests at the end, and the ink swells into a bead, wicks out along the fibres and dries into a dark coffee ring. Sign it yourself and it pools where you pause, thins where you flick, and Sign and book lifts a mirrored blotter offprint of whatever is still wet.
intent: One mechanic finished to the edge: a GPU paper-and-ink simulation inside an ordinary signature field, where pooling, feathering, coffee-ring drying and a blotter offprint all come from the same water and pigment.
